general_terms: The five-tier XP thresholds and the specific monetary rewards, cashback rates, bonus caps and wagering requirements in this knowledge base are modeled values rather than verified current BC.GAME rules.
Published BC.GAME materials describe VIP levels, level-up bonuses, rakeback, recharge, cashback and personalized VIP services, but benefits and eligibility may change.
